Jump into the action with four more heart-pounding ChuChu TV Police adventures! Chief ChuChu and her team rescue a stolen lion cub from the Masai Mara, crack a case involving spooky ghost sightings, foil thieves in an underground railroad chase, and recover the world's biggest chocolate from a festival heist.
Each episode is cleverly written to show children that good triumphs over greed — not through violence, but through wit, teamwork, and never giving up. These are the stories that children request over and over, and that parents feel good about saying yes to.
